lessons: Criterion 3 requires `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` to pass on the whole repo. The merge base fails both across chupa/, eval/, tests/ and tickets/*/evidence, and all of these are outside the fence. Engine-code and test changes are also forbidden, so no attempt can pass as written.
Before re-running, the repo must be lint- and format-clean (box-000338-98ba883a), done by a separate ticket that this one depends on. Re-measure the coverage baseline only after that cleanup merges.

Ticket evidence files (tickets/graph-lane-cleanup/evidence/regress_graph_lanes.py, tickets/status-optional-locks/evidence/stale_lock.py) fail ruff. A human must decide whether the cleanup ticket fixes them or ruff excludes tickets/. The ticket does not say which is allowed.

The covgate.py coverage changed from 19 to 23 between unit runs, so the measured floor is not stable. The baseline check needs a deterministic per-file measurement, or the ticket must say how to pick the floor when runs disagree.
